questions.q: What does Peale claim determines your reality?
questions.why: He says reality is determined by what you think about everything you experience.

questions.q: How does Peale suggest reducing worry?
a: Imagine a future self without worry
questions.why: He recommends visualizing a worry‑free future to lessen current worries.

questions.q: What concept does Peale link to believing in yourself?
questions.why: He describes confidence leading to outcomes as a self‑fulfilling prophecy.

questions.q: According to Peale, confidence alone cannot replace what?
questions.why: He notes confidence isn't the same as competence, e.g., praising a poor math student won't improve performance.

questions.q: Which earlier author discussed the self‑fulfilling prophecy before Peale?
questions.why: The text mentions Napoleon Hill addressed the idea 80 years earlier.
